subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue remain the canonical multi-agent reliability umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for completion isolation and session ownership?
rationale: The remaining work spans session ownership, subagent completion guarantees, fallback-lane behavior, detached child cleanup, and possible isolation semantics, so automation should not choose the final product boundary.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review focused fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close this only after the linked lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or split.

options.title: Promote Isolation Design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical product direction and explicitly map remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Select one canonical issue per root cause, link the production evidence to each owner, and close this umbrella only after the split is complete.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review focused fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close this only after the linked lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or split.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily an architecture/product-boundary choice across core agent orchestration and VISION guardrails, and steipete is the strongest available routing owner from history and policy context.
